description: Library Maintenance's comparison of a duplicate group's copies, as admin, on the desktop (1366 px), on a phone (375 px) and on jellyfin-web's TV layout. The group is 'LM Compare Pair' when the sandbox has it (two differing copies, one with special features), else the first group. What the open comparison shows is what GET /LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Groups/{id}/Compare gives: a column per copy with its file name, the audio and subtitle track counts, the special features, and 'Best' on the copies the server names for each detail; the toggle says aria-expanded and aria-controls; nothing scrolls sideways on a phone (the table's rows stack); on the TV, OK on 'Compare copies' opens it and Down moves into it. Reads only; this browser's kept choices and layout are removed at the end.

steps.name: the server's group and its comparison
steps.eval: (async () => { const groups = (await __lmc.api('LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Groups?limit=200')).body; const g = groups.Items.find(x => x.DisplayTitle === 'LM Compare Pair') || groups.Items[0]; if (!g) { return null; } const r = await __lmc.api('LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Groups/' + g.GroupId + '/Compare'); const c = r.body; const guid = (x) => String(x).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); return { id: g.GroupId, title: g.DisplayTitle, onFirstPage: groups.Items.indexOf(g) < 50, status: r.status, copies: c.Copies.map(x => ({ id: guid(x.ItemId), file: x.FileName || x.Name, audio: x.Audio.length, subtitles: x.Subtitles.length, features: x.SpecialFeatures.Count })), best: c.Best.map(b => ({ field: b.Field, copies: b.ItemIds.map(i => c.Copies.findIndex(x => guid(x.ItemId) === guid(i)) + 1) })) }; })()

[...row(name).querySelectorAll('td')] : []; const count = (td) => { const m = /^(\d+)[ :]/.exec((td.querySelector('.jflm-page-compare-count') || {}).textContent || ''); return m ? Number(m[1]) : 0; }; const best = {}; rows.forEach(r => { const n = [...r.querySelectorAll('td')].map((td, i) => td.classList.contains('jflm-page-compare-best') ? i + 1 : 0).filter(Boolean); if (n.length) { best[r.getAttribute('data-row')] = n; } }); return { expanded: toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), controls: toggle.getAttribute('aria-controls') === panel.id, region: panel.getAttribute('role'), shown: !__lmc.hidden(panel), files: [...table.querySelectorAll('thead .jflm-page-compare-file')].map(x => x.textContent), audio: cells('Audio').map(count), subtitles: cells('Subtitles').map(count), features: cells('Special features').map(count), best, differs: rows.filter(r => r.querySelector('.jflm-page-compare-differs')).map(r => r.getAttribute('data-row')), opens: [...table.querySelectorAll('thead a.jflm-page-open')].map(a => a.getAttribute('aria-label')), requests: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => e.name.indexOf('/Compare') >= 0).length }; })()

steps.name: the server's comparison: a column per copy with its file, the track and feature counts, Best where the server says
steps.assert: (() => { const s = __vars.server, w = __vars.shown; const rowOf = { Resolution: 'Resolution', Size: 'Size', Bitrate: 'Bitrate', VideoBitrate: 'Video bitrate', BitDepth: 'Bit depth', DynamicRange: 'Dynamic range', AudioTracks: 'Audio', AudioChannels: 'Most channels', SubtitleTracks: 'Subtitles', SpecialFeatures: 'Special features' }; return w.expanded === 'true' && w.controls && w.region === 'region' && w.shown && w.files.join('|') === s.copies.map(c => c.file).join('|') && w.audio.join() === s.copies.map(c => c.audio).join() && w.subtitles.join() === s.copies.map(c => c.subtitles).join() && w.features.join() === s.copies.map(c => c.features).join() && s.best.every(b => (w.best[rowOf[b.field]] || []).join() === b.copies.join()) && Object.keys(w.best).length === s.best.length && w.opens.length === s.copies.length && w.requests >= 1; })()
